use_drop_path_function: use the drop_path function to apply stochastic depth dropout to a tensor during training
create_DropPath_module: create a DropPath module to apply stochastic depth dropout with a given drop probability
build_GraphDropPath_module: build a GraphDropPath module to drop paths considering batch indices for graph data
review_EquivariantDropout_class: review the EquivariantDropout class to apply equivariant dropout using e3nn irreps and elementwise tensor product
test_EquivariantScalarsDropout: test the EquivariantScalarsDropout class to apply dropout only to scalar irreps in equivariant tensors
